method: IPC-2221 chart fit; outer 35 um, inner 17 um, via plating 18 um; branch currents from a layer-aware resistive copper graph with finite via barrels and ideal filled plane islands
converter_screen_basis: TI TPS62160 family Rev E electrical characteristics: static ILIM max 2.45 A at VIN=12 V, TJ=25 C, rounded to 2.5 A; dynamic comparator delay is typical 30 ns, so this is a screening envelope, not a guaranteed peak bound.
limitations: Fuse cases use nameplate currents, not hard limits; source prospective current, fuse time-current/clearing I-squared-t and short-pulse copper survival need validation.
Board fuses do not protect entry copper upstream of themselves; the 5-V harness requires its documented tap-end fuse, and the host 3.3-V entry short needs source review.
Filled planes are ideal electrical hubs; plane constrictions, ground return, thermal environment and actual supplier stack/plating require engineering review.
2.5-A converter screen does not bound dynamic peaks or all input/temperature conditions.
